shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat AGENTS.md package.json next.config.ts app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx lib/projects.ts && git status --short && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.git'"' -g '"'!.next'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/projects.ts next.config.ts && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- next-env.d.ts tsconfig.json && rg --files .next/server/app | head -25 && node -e \"const fs = require('node:fs'); const html = fs.readFileSync('.next/server/app/index.html', 'utf8'); console.log(html.slice(0, html.indexOf('</main>') + 7)); const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.next/prerender-manifest.json', 'utf8')); console.log(JSON.stringify(manifest.routes['/'], null, 2));\""
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && rg -n 'instant\\s*=\\s*false|force-dynamic|force-static|unstable_noStore|connection\\(|fetchCache|revalidate\\s*=' app lib next.config.ts; git diff --stat"
